messages:
harper (product): Quick follow-up to the deprecation plan: I'm publishing a short FAQ + customer comms templates and scheduling two office hours for external-facing teams. Need sign-off on the email + support scripts. :speech_balloon:

noah (eng): Thanks. Can you paste the proposed customer-facing subject line? Legal asked for conservative wording.

lee (docs): Draft email subject: `Important: Upcoming SDK migration & support timeline (action recommended)`
Draft snippet for body (short):

```
Hi <customer-team>,

We're deprecating the legacy sync SDK bindings. We expect a 12-month window and have tools (compat shim + codemod) to help migration. See: https://redwood.internal/docs/migration

If you'd like a migration plan or need an extension for a private deployment, reply to this message and we'll schedule a session.

—The Redwood Inference Team
```

zane (support): I'll convert that into two canned replies: (1) general migration info, (2) extension request flow. Also need an internal KB entry for triage steps.

mika (legal): Tone looks fine. Suggest replacing "deprecating" with "scheduled migration" in the outward-facing subject to reduce alarm. Example subject: `Scheduled migration: SDK update and recommended actions`

lee (docs): Updated subject per legal: `Scheduled migration: SDK update and recommended actions`
I'll push the email template and two canned Slack replies to the draft KB page.

harper (product): Office hours: Wednesday 11am PT and Friday 3pm PT. I've added calendar events and invited customer success, support, and solutions. deploy-bot: can you post those in #customers?

deploy-bot: Posted office hours announcement to #customers: "Office hours — SDK migration Q&A: Wed 11am PT, Fri 3pm PT"

zane (support): Also adding a short troubleshooting flow: 1) confirm SDK version 2) recommend shim if tests failing 3) escalate for private deployments. I'll draft it and link it to KB.

noah (eng): Quick technical Q for docs: can you include a tiny compatibility table in the FAQ showing which runtime builds are supported by the shim (x86, aarch64, quantized INT8)? I can supply the rows.

lee (docs): Yes — please drop the rows here or in the RFC and I'll surface them as a mini table. We'll mark the table as "engineering-verified".

mika (legal): One more note: for customers under active enterprise contracts, include a line: "Contact your account team before migrating to request any contractual exceptions." That avoids accidental SLA issues.

harper (product): Great. Action items: lee -> publish FAQ + email templates (48h), zane -> KB canned replies (48h), noah -> drop compatibility rows (24h), mika -> final legal blurb (24h). docs-bot: create page and mark draft.

docs-bot: Created draft: /docs/announcements/sdk-migration-faq and /docs/kb/sdk-migration-canned-replies (draft).

lee (docs): Will also include a short example Slack post for partners: `Heads up: we're migrating SDK bindings. See migration guide: <link>` — one-line, low-friction.

harper (product): Thanks all. If anyone has objections to the wording, reply here. Otherwise we'll send the first batch of customer emails after legal signs off. :white_check_mark:
